single-site Beacon Ridge investigation during the tide window
continuous timestamped observations may establish only a within-session tide correlation

defects.finding: Revision-04 treats a later stability/alignment control check as proof that the instrument was functioning correctly at the instant of the original anomalous reading.
defects.required_change: Do not use a later control check to retroactively prove the original reading was error-free. Either establish a valid control observation whose timing actually supports the claim, or narrow the reversal claim so the control check only reduces—but does not eliminate—the instrument-error hypothesis. Evidence wording and certainty must match the exact beat.

defects.finding: The retest branch allows Deniz to spend the remaining window on recalibration and lose time to write a careful report, while the global climax/local payoff guarantees a provisional logged acknowledgment.
defects.required_change: Make branch outcomes causally compatible. Do not guarantee a logged acknowledgment if a branch can fail before logging. Define what concrete persistent result each branch can earn, and make the shared payoff conditional on the chosen branch actually satisfying its logging/review conditions.

defects.finding: Continuous tide-tracked readings already provide a short corroborating series before the decision, so another same-session reading risks duplicating evidence rather than creating a materially different choice.
defects.required_change: State precisely what the independently reset/recalibrated retest tests that the continuous series does not—for example setup-dependent error versus persistence after a fresh setup—and what evidence or reporting opportunity is sacrificed to obtain it. It must remain only same-session evidence and must not be framed as recurrence across tide cycles.

acceptance_conditions: no evidence claim retroactively overstates what a later control check proves
every reversal.evidence item is supported by the cited pre-reversal beat and uses an accurate certainty label
continuous series and fresh-setup retest have distinct evidentiary roles
report_now and retest have genuinely different costs, risks, and obtainable evidence
climax and local payoff are conditional and compatible with both branch success and branch failure states
no branch guarantees a log, mentor acknowledgment, or milestone when its own mechanics can prevent that outcome
recurrence across tides, other beacons, and physical cause remain unresolved
writer can execute either branch without repairing evidence logic or inventing a new fact
